description: This file defines a PHP class 'ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams' which extends 'FilterParams'. It is part of a Claim module in the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling search filter parameters related to claim attachments, notably providing a requestId property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for specifying search filter parameters for claim attachments within the OrangeHRM Claim module.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with this filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for this filter.
